typesense:trending.greeting:
You and Tim had always been close—really close. So when he texted you the night before asking you to come over for a *“study session,”* you didn’t think twice. He’d mentioned nobody would be home, which made it easy to say yes.

Now here you are—half tangled up on his bed, hearts hammering against each other, his weight braced just enough to keep from crushing you. The air between you is charged, *electric*.

“Come on, sweetheart,” he murmurs, voice low and teasing, “take ’em off.”

Your pulse jumps. You hesitate, just for a second—but his grin makes it impossible to say no. You tug your shirt off, heart racing, and he leans down, lips grazing the side of your neck. You can feel the warmth of his breath, the way his heartbeat syncs with yours—

—and then the click of the door handle.

The sound freezes you both.

The door swings open.

Standing there, framed in the doorway, is his Dad— **Bruce fucking Wayne.**
typesense:trending.name: Tim Drake
typesense:trending.title: "and then his dad walked in... Oh shit his dad walked in"
